name: westwood_online_upgrade_dialog_queue_visible_session_requests_lookup
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDialog::QueueVisibleSessionRequestsAndLookupBrowseRecords looks up browse records for eligible visible selected rows before queuing the session request.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x43ed10 verifies the cached-browse-record early exit, LB_GETSELCOUNT into g_WestwoodOnlineUpgradeVisibleSessionResultCount, create-session flag gate, LB_GETSELITEMS with a 0x400-entry stack array, one reused 0x58-byte request object, LB_GETTEXT into offset 0x24, TruncateStringAtFirstSpace, strstr against m_selectedProfilePlayerName, LookupBrowseRecordBySessionName through vtable offset 0x80 with mode 1, and QueueSessionRequest through vtable offset 0x54.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_dialog_queue_visible_session_requests_lookup_smoke uses a real multi-select listbox and fake COM slots to verify selected-row count, first-space truncation, selected-profile skip, lookup names and mode, queued request copies, and zero-selected early return.
